mapper.sql: id, product_id, user_id, order_id, rating, content, images, is_anonymous, status, create_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM product_review WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_review WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND status = 1

SELECT r.id, r.product_id AS productId, r.user_id AS userId, r.order_id AS orderId, r.rating, r.content, r.images, r.is_anonymous AS isAnonymous, r.status, r.create_time AS createTime, p.name AS productName, p.main_image AS productImage FROM product_review r LEFT JOIN product p ON p.id = r.product_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT AVG(rating) FROM product_review WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_review (product_id, user_id, order_id, rating, content, images, is_anonymous, status, create_time) VALUES (#{productId}, #{userId}, #{orderId}, #{rating}, #{content}, #{images}, #{isAnonymous}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE product_review SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
